items.handling: Recorded here and in the dated dossier with the run ids. The regression that blocked every refresh is fixed in this PR (see 73bc57bd-duplicate-no-line-research-id) after the wall-clock errors were cleared by PR #240; the next scheduled run therefore collects and publishes, and the nine cards enter the normal ladder — five already show a real two-sided external price, four show only placeholder books that the existing policy correctly refuses.

items.finding: The built executive summary carries id="no-line-research" twice (the summary and its compact unresolved register both render the dated block), which is an invalid duplicate landmark target and is asserted against by the existing test.
items.handling: Fixed in this PR after a documented takeover. The defect was claimed by arena-be019782 (PR #237, still open) but main stayed red: run 40063011446 and the next three scheduled runs failed on this assertion, and PR #240 (merged 2026-10-24T06:10Z) only cleared the wall-clock errors. Because a red main means no refresh can publish, the minimal non-destructive change was applied: the compact register no longer emits the block a second time, so summary() renders it exactly once and /unresolved/ keeps its own copy. Nothing else in scripts/build.py changed and none of the owning session's work was reverted; their PR keeps its fuller change set. Verified: site/index.html and site/unresolved/index.html each contain exactly one id="no-line-research"; tests.test_ca7e10e5_snapshot, tests.test_eea4c104_audit, tests.test_42bfa8ea and tests.test_3016b0c6_mobile_glance all pass (76 targeted tests green).

evidence.detail: summary() and unresolved_register(..., compact=True) both emit the dated research block.

items.finding: All 17 pick rows on the published build reproduce their probability from the evidence the row itself carries, with zero drift: 12 quote-based rows replay from their bid/ask midpoints or proportional no-vig decimal prices, and 5 model rows replay from their two Valve rating totals as 1/(1+10^(-diff*g/400)) with the g the row publishes. No row needed an unexplained adjustment, and no Hotspawn "% picked" figure or HLTV fan vote enters any row.
items.handling: scripts/73bc57bd_provenance.py replays every row offline from the branch-root build and tests/test_73bc57bd_provenance.py pins the arithmetic; the dated report is linked. The audit is read-only: it reports a row it cannot reproduce instead of repairing it.

items.finding: FlyQuest vs Staqued (1082860) publishes FlyQuest 92.3% from a Thunderpick price of 1.001 / 12.00. A 1.001 decimal price returns a tenth of a percent and prints as "1.00" on the row, which a reader cannot tell apart from a missing value. The same project already refuses Polymarket 93-95¢ zero-volume placeholders, so the floor is applied unevenly: there is no lower bound on a bookmaker quote.
items.handling: Flagged, not re-priced: dropping the row would remove a pick the brief requires, and rewriting the number would be an inference. The request for the owner of the pricing gate (scripts/originate.py) is logged in COORDINATION.md: reject or clearly annotate a quote at or below 1.01 the way zero-volume placeholders are rejected, and never render a price below 1.01 as "1.00".

items.finding: All three bookmaker rows (1082860, 1082859, 1082923) cite https://thunderpick.io/api/matches, which is the provider API root, not the market the price came from. The fixture is only identifiable through an event id buried in the JSON, so the "source link" the brief requires on every row cannot actually be used to check the price. The model and market rows do carry fixture-specific links.
items.handling: The audit reports a generic-link finding per row. Where the provider publishes no stable public market URL, the honest fix is to print the event id on the row next to the provider name; that is a build change owned elsewhere, so it is logged rather than edited here.

evidence.detail: audit finding generic_evidence_link on three rows
the URL all three rows cite

items.finding: Ten rows show no series format at all, while their own research trail records "HLTV lists BO3". Leaving the Hotspawn field blank is correct - the Hotspawn format is separately unverified - but the reader is shown an empty cell and nothing distinguishes "unverified" from "not looked at", even though a cited source already answered the question.
items.handling: Reported, not filled: writing BO3 into a field that means "Hotspawn format" would mix two providers. The recommended change is to render the verified HLTV format with its source beside the blank field; logged for the owner of the summary renderer.

evidence.detail: audit finding blank_format_with_confirmed_format on ten rows

items.finding: One build tells two stories. snapshot.json reports counts.unresolved = 2 and carries no analysis for Ground Zero vs Off Chops (1082858) and HOTU vs The Huns (1082792), while the executive summary says "0 explicitly unresolved" and both pages show those fixtures with a directional pick (55.1% and 94.1%). items.handling: The two layers are intentional - the snapshot is the priced layer, the page also carries the origination model - but the mismatch is not disclosed anywhere on the site. Flagged for the owner of the snapshot writer so the JSON either carries the resolved picks or states that its counts describe the priced layer only.

items.handling: The concurrency comment in .github/workflows/pages.yml already documents this exact cancellation mode for 2026-10-22; the fix that survived is a scheduled run in its own concurrency group, plus the merged freshness watchdog.
